stations.title: Bryn
stations.say: Order NaN tins of Frost Sencha?

stations.title: Rafe's settings
stations.text: Strict checks off, so the compiler is quiet.

captions: Bryn asks why the reorder list says NaN tins of Frost Sencha at Oakhollow.
Rafe switched the strict checks off, so the compiler stayed quiet about the bug.
You switch the checks on one at a time in tsconfig.json, and fix what each one finds.
The compiler finds the mistake, and Bryn gets a real number of tins to order.
The stock code now compiles with every check on, so the compiler speaks up first.
